name: jev-gate
description: Jev policies for Claude Code and native Codex: task routing, observed contract checks, evidence, compaction, output folding and a live dashboard.

scripts.build: rm -rf dist && tsc -p tsconfig.json && node scripts/build-evidence.mjs && node scripts/build-codex.mjs
scripts.release:pin: npm run build && node scripts/release.mjs pin
scripts.release:check: npm run build && node scripts/release.mjs check
